env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTI: Everyday work: GPT-4.1 with StackSpot's prompt, finishes tasks, ~2x faster

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | grep -o '"display_name":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); dir=$(echo "$input" | grep -o '"current_dir":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); printf 'StackSpot ▸ %s ▸ 127.0.0.1:18880 ▸ %s' "${model:-GPT-5.1}" "${dir##*/}"
